--help:
chkit v{version} - ClickHouse toolkit

Usage:
  chkit <command> [options]

Commands:
  init           Scaffold a new project with config and example schema
  add            Add an app's editable schema and ingestion code to the project
  registry       Browse apps and integration guides, inspect sync coverage, or build templates
  skills         Manage agent skills (proxies to the `skills` CLI)
  generate       Generate migration artifacts from schema definitions
  migrate        Review or execute pending migrations
  status         Show migration status and checksum mismatch information
  drift          Compare snapshot state with current ClickHouse objects
  check          Run policy checks for CI and release gates
  snapshot       Rebuild snapshot.json from schema definitions (usage: chkit snapshot rebuild [--dryrun])
  query          Run a SQL query against the configured target
  plugin         List plugins and run plugin namespace commands

Global options:
  --help-plugins         Show help with configured plugin flags (loads config, skips initialization hooks)
  -c, --config <path>    Path to config file
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON output
  -h, --help             Show help
  -v, -V, --version      Show version

Documentation:
  Full documentation: https://chkit.obsessiondb.com/
  Agent-readable markdown: fetch any docs page with Accept: text/markdown
init --help:
chkit init [options]

Create a TypeScript config and example schema; install project dependencies.

  -y, --yes                 Skip interactive onboarding
  --connect <choice>        claim, account, clickhouse, or later
  --email <email>           Email for account onboarding
  --code <code>             Verification code
  --org-name <name>         Organization name
  -h, --help                Show help without creating files or connecting
generate --help:
chkit generate [options]
  Generate migration artifacts from schema definitions

Options:
  -t, --table <selector>
                        Limit command scope to tables by exact name or trailing wildcard prefix
  -n, --name <name>      Migration name
  --migration-id <id>    Override the default timestamp migration prefix
  --rename-table <mapping>
                        Explicit table rename mapping
  --rename-column <mapping>
                        Explicit column rename mapping
  --rename-dictionary <mapping>
                        Explicit dictionary rename mapping
  --dryrun               Print plan without writing artifacts
  --empty                Scaffold a blank manual migration (no schema diff, snapshot untouched)
  --cutover <database.table=key>
                        Cut a structural table change over without downtime, keyed by a unique key
  --cutover-copy <mode>  Where the cutover copies existing rows: migration (default) or backfill
  --cutover-old <mode>   What happens to the pre-cutover table: keep (default, as <table>_previous) or drop
  --drop-retained <database.table>
                        Drop a table a cutover retained

Global options:
  --help-plugins         Show help with configured plugin flags (loads config, skips initialization hooks)
  -c, --config <path>    Path to config file
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON output
  -h, --help             Show help; use --help-plugins to include configured extensions

migrate --help:
chkit migrate [options]
  Review or execute pending migrations

Options:
  -t, --table <selector>
                        Limit command scope to tables by exact name or trailing wildcard prefix
  --apply                Apply pending migrations on ClickHouse (no prompt)
  --execute              Alias for --apply
  --allow-destructive    Allow destructive migrations tagged with risk=danger
  --retry <migration>    Resume a failed migration after editing its file (skips completed statements)
  --abandon <migration>  Reset a failed migration so the next apply runs it from statement 1 (journal only; previews without --apply)
  --break-lock <claim>   Release the migrate lock claim of a run that is no longer running, then take the lock
  --setting <name=value>
                        ClickHouse query setting sent with each migration statement, e.g. max_table_size_to_drop=0 (repeatable)
  --cancel-lock-queries  Cancel the tracked queries of the stopped --break-lock run before recovery (requires --apply)
